title: Purple Alien Astronaut
description: A purple-skinned alien with bright green eyes wears an ornate golden space helmet and armored suit. The figure holds a dark clump of black material connected by golden rings and chains, with one hand raised in a gesture, set against a light background with floating orbs and faint symbols.
prompt: A purple-skinned alien with glowing green eyes, wearing an intricate golden space helmet and armored suit with segmented details, holds a dark clump of black organic material connected by floating golden rings and chains. One hand is raised elegantly. The character has delicate wings, floating glowing orbs and faint circular symbols fill the light background with ink splatter effects, digital painting style, detailed linework.
